method: Editorial review of original FDA notice text and product tables. Recall fields are audited separately against immutable API records; no patient/unit safety certification.

notices.scope: Unused Infinion CX lead kits SC-2317-50 and SC-2317-70; all lots of those named kits.
notices.finding: Anchor-site mechanical stress can cause high impedance or fracture. The removal concerns unused leads; FDA says no monitoring beyond routine follow-up for already implanted devices.
notices.limitation: Does not establish a recall of every Precision pulse generator or other lead model.
notices.locator: Affected Product; What to Do; Reason for Recall/Correction

notices.finding: A flange/cannula disconnection can obstruct breathing. FDA reports no affected units distributed in the US.
notices.limitation: This tracheostomy product is different from K250173 oral/nasal RAE endotracheal tubes; rejected as a direct model match.
notices.locator: Affected Product; What to Do; Reason for Recall/Correction

notices.scope: Breast-implant capsule cancers; no model/lot-specific recall is established by this communication.
notices.finding: FDA describes rare SCC reports with unknown incidence, cause and risk factors, distinct from BIA-ALCL; asymptomatic removal solely for this concern is not recommended.
notices.limitation: This is class-level surveillance information, not proof that a particular Natrelle style caused SCC.
notices.locator: Affected Product; What to Do; Reason for Recall/Correction

notices.scope: AC cord 107760 for MPU 107754; fifteen listed lots from 10763925 through 10831828 (not a continuous range).
notices.finding: A defective locking feature can permit power disconnection. The notice removes affected cords, not every MPU or implanted pump.
notices.limitation: Compare the exact lot list in the source; intermediate numbers are not presumed included.
notices.locator: Affected Product; What to Do; Reason for Recall/Correction

notices.scope: HeartMate MPU 107754 and listed regional references/serials, UDI-DI 05415067038234.
notices.finding: Certain electrical components can cause sudden power loss. FDA links the actual serial list and manufacturer lookup; the accessory serves HeartMate II and 3.
notices.limitation: The referenced manufacturer serial list, rather than family name alone, governs applicability.
notices.locator: Affected Product; What to Do; Reason for Recall/Correction

notices.scope: HeartMate System Monitor, listed references; all serial numbers; UDI-DI 00813024010142 and 00813024010852.
notices.finding: Display faults can cause unintended setting changes or pump-stop commands; the communication concerns the clinical monitor, not removal of every implanted pump.
notices.limitation: Follow the original correction and current manufacturer instructions; no patient-specific action is determined here.
notices.locator: Affected Product; What to Do; Reason for Recall/Correction

notices.finding: The correction addresses leakage or air entry observed during implantation and keeps unused product in the field under updated precautions.
notices.limitation: HeartMate 3-specific notice; rejected as a direct HeartMate II model match.
notices.locator: Affected Product; What to Do; Reason for Recall/Correction

notices.scope: Listed HeartMate II and HeartMate 3 graft/implant-kit references; see source’s complete model table.
notices.finding: Biological-material buildup can obstruct the outflow graft, often after prolonged support. This is a correction with low-flow-alarm assessment guidance.
notices.limitation: The exact graft/kit configuration matters; a recall record does not mean preventive removal is recommended.
notices.locator: Affected Product; What to Do; Reason for Recall/Correction

notices.scope: HeartMate Touch communication software v1.0.32 used with HeartMate 3.
notices.finding: Disconnecting/reconnecting with a queued stop command can unexpectedly stop or start the pump; the notice updates the command-completion procedure.
notices.limitation: The source identifies HeartMate 3 support; rejected as an established HeartMate II-specific notice.
notices.locator: Affected Product; What to Do; Reason for Recall/Correction

notices.scope: Pipeline Vantage 027 removal versus Vantage 021 IFU correction; listed catalogs/lots B317266 through B817292.
notices.finding: Incomplete wall apposition or braid deformation prompted removal of unused 027 devices and updated 021 deployment instructions. The two actions are distinct.
notices.limitation: This is not a blanket recall of Pipeline Classic, Flex or every Shield device. Exact catalog, lot and updated IFU are required.
notices.locator: Affected Product; What to Do; Reason for Recall/Correction

notices.scope: Inspire IV generator 3028; only the affected serials identified by FDA.
notices.finding: A manufacturing defect can cause sensing-circuit leakage and loss/inappropriate delivery of therapy; the notice directs noninvasive follow-up and clinician assessment.
notices.limitation: Not a blanket recall of Inspire II/3024 or all 3028 units. The page’s stated device count and displayed serial list should be reconciled with the recall database/manufacturer.
notices.locator: Affected Product; What to Do; Reason for Recall/Correction

notices.scope: Listed WATCHMAN TruSeal, fixed-curve and TruSteer access systems; all lots of listed material numbers.
notices.finding: The IFU correction addresses air ingress/embolism during transseptal procedures, especially without positive-pressure ventilation. FDA says already implanted patients need no extra management for this issue.
notices.limitation: Procedure/access-system warning, not evidence that every implanted WATCHMAN closure device should be removed.
notices.locator: Affected Product; What to Do; Reason for Recall/Correction

notices.scope: Paclitaxel-coated peripheral arterial devices; FDA July 11, 2023 update.
notices.finding: FDA’s updated review does not support excess late mortality. The 2019 concern is historical context, not an unchanged current conclusion.
notices.limitation: Does not exclude bleeding, thrombosis, device-specific recall risks or future evidence changes.

notices.scope: Allergan BIOCELL textured implant and tissue-expander products identified in July 2019.
notices.finding: The recall addresses BIA-ALCL risk associated with the named textured products. It is not a recall of every smooth Natrelle implant; FDA did not recommend removal in asymptomatic patients.
notices.limitation: Use the implant card and full product table; individual risk and symptoms require clinical assessment.

notices.scope: Boston Scientific Infinion CX leads SC-2317-50 / SC-2317-70.
notices.finding: The notice concerns Boston Scientific lead kits, not Nuvectra Algovita components.
notices.limitation: Rejected as an Algovita-specific recall. A shared spinal-cord-stimulation class does not establish component compatibility or applicability.
notices.locator: Affected Product; What to Do; Reason for Recall/Correction

141612.scope: RADIESSE+ lidocaine 1.5cc, P/N 8063M0K1, lot 100083189. Incorrect encoded UDI expiry; source action refers to the printed USE BEFORE date.
141612.finding: The original FDA page also says P050052/SO52 (letter O). Product context is documented, but the malformed identifier is not silently repaired.

122048.scope: Valiant/Talent with Captivia; source lists TB/TF/TW/TA/VAM catalog patterns and international distribution. Flushing difficulty prompted an information letter.
122048.finding: The original FDA page also says P100040/P070. Product context is documented, but the malformed application suffix remains excluded from accepted joins.
